domain: finite-dimensional vector spaces over a finite field; k indexed geometric subspace classes U_j with multiplicities a_j >= 1
rank_oracle: rho(X)=dim(sum_{j in X} U_j) for X subseteq K
state: P subseteq S subseteq K, equivalently ternary Done/Active/NotStarted; Q=S\P and R=K\S. Singleton classes may only be NotStarted or Done and never Active.
state_width_derivation: The left span is sum_{j in S}U_j and the right span is sum_{j in K\P}U_j. Their sum is the full arrangement span sum_{j in K}U_j, so Grassmann's identity gives lambda=rho(S)+rho(K\P)-rho(K).

transitions.singleton: if a_j=1 and j notin S: (P,S)->(P union {j}, S union {j})
transitions.repeated_start: if a_j>=2 and j notin S: (P,S)->(P, S union {j})
transitions.repeated_finish: if a_j>=2 and j in S\P: (P,S)->(P union {j}, S)

topological_measure: |P|+|S| strictly increases by exactly one on every transition
correctness_statement: Every source-to-sink path in the state DAG is in bijection with a precedence-respecting endpoint order of the endpoint-compressed arrangement and has bottleneck cost equal to that layout width. Therefore dp[K,K] equals exact repeated-class path-width by the admitted endpoint-compression theorem.

complexity_claim.singleton_count: s = number of j with a_j=1
complexity_claim.repeated_count: r = number of j with a_j>=2; s+r=k
complexity_claim.exact_directed_transitions: s*2^(s-1)*3^r + 2r*2^s*3^(r-1), with the first term interpreted as 0 when s=0 and the second as 0 when r=0
complexity_claim.state_width_after_rank_precompute: O(1) table lookups and integer arithmetic
complexity_claim.total: O(2^k*poly(d,input)+k*3^k) finite-field linear algebra / combinatorial work
complexity_claim.parameterized_classification_candidate: FPT in k, the number of distinct geometric subspace classes
